scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An empty stone gateway with open wooden doors frames a street of stone buildings beneath a gray, clouded sky.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a young man gestures as he speaks to a young woman standing apart among pottery and woven fabrics.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A younger man gestures as he speaks to an older man seated in a sunlit stone courtyard.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Grieving and angry men return along a field path toward a man beside a tent encampment; one bows his head while another clenches his fists.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an older man gestures as he speaks to a group of reserved listeners, while a younger man stands behind him.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elder gestures toward another family group as men and women listen in a sunlit ancient village landscape.
